name: figma-ui-color-palette
description: UI Color Palette is a Figma and FigJam plugin that creates, manages, exports, and publishes consistent and accessible color palettes.
author: Aurélien Grimaud

scripts.install:ext: npm install --workspaces && npm install --workspace=packages/ui-ui-color-palette/packages/auth-yelbolt --workspaces && npm install --prefix packages/ui-ui-color-palette/packages/auth-yelbolt/ui-color-palette
scripts.start:dev:all: npm run build:one & npm run build:team
scripts.build:one: cross-env PLUGIN=one npx vite build --mode development & cross-env IS_PLUGIN=true PLUGIN=one npx vite build --mode development
scripts.build:team: cross-env PLUGIN=team npx vite build --mode development & cross-env IS_PLUGIN=true PLUGIN=team npx vite build --mode development
scripts.build:all: npm run build:one & npm run build:team
scripts.build:prod:one: cross-env PLUGIN=one npx vite build --mode production && cross-env IS_PLUGIN=true PLUGIN=one npx vite build --mode production
scripts.build:prod:team: cross-env PLUGIN=team npx vite build --mode production && cross-env IS_PLUGIN=true PLUGIN=team npx vite build --mode production
scripts.build:prod:all: npm run build:prod:one & npm run build:prod:team
